checks.sentence: In FY2013 and FY2014, it recorded losses of ₹27.40 lakh and ₹12.17 lakh respectively.
FY2017 saw the highest full-year profit at ₹174.82 lakh, and the first half of FY2018 alone generated ₹132.75 lakh — already 76% of the prior full year.

From a loss of ₹0.45 per share in FY2013 and ₹0.20 in FY2014, EPS turned positive at ₹2.47 in FY2015, dipped to ₹1.46 in FY2016, recovered to ₹2.43 in FY2017, and stood at ₹1.48 for the six months ended September 2017.
The company generated positive operating cash flow in FY2013 (₹200.97 lakh), FY2014 (₹127.73 lakh), FY2015 (₹422.36 lakh), and FY2016 (₹802.59 lakh — the strongest year).
But in FY2017, operating cash flow turned sharply negative at ₹349.75 lakh outflow.
